notes.general_comments: General comments This paper tested the candidates’ knowledge and understanding of important aspects of AS Level Chemistry. The overall standard achieved by candidates was similar to last year, with an encouraging performance in the calculation questions. Most candidates showed some positive achievement. Questions 1 and 4 involved much factual recall and showed which candidates had concentrated on this aspect of their revision. Full credit was common for good candidates in Question 2, which involved mainly calculations. The calculation in Question 3(b)(i) was also well done and sound answers were given in 3(c). Question 5 involved some organic problem solving where the better candidates provided good answers.
